---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or operational enhancement for ParkSphere
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Context**
A clear and concise description of the feature and which user workflow it addresses.

**Expected Behavior**
Describe the intended user journey (Customer, Operator, or Admin).

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Conforms to the ParkSphere Project Bible
- [ ] Backend route, controller, service, validation, and tests implemented
- [ ] Frontend page/component with 5 required UI states (loading, empty, error, success, forbidden)
- [ ] No secrets leaked; role-based authorization enforced

**Dependencies**
List any related models, modules, or services affected.

**Test Notes**
List the tests planned to verify this feature.
